description: Project Quote — the project approver's read + accept view of the quote the equipment manager generated. Project counterpart of customer-portal/customer-quote-page, with one deliberate difference: accepting does NOT create a Fusion sell contract (a project quote is an internal cost estimate, not a sale), so there is no contractNumber and no contract-creation overlay.

requestId.description: Human-readable request number (e.g. REQ-1042). Used for the page title and as a fallback match.

requestNumericId.description: EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST.EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST_ID — the key for the quote-document endpoint and the accept PATCHes.

requestStatus.description: Header status, resolved in ProjectQuoteInitChain. Gates Accept: only QUOTE_GENERATED is acceptable; QUOTE_ACCEPTED and beyond render as already-accepted.

quotePdfUrl.description: Object URL for the PDF blob fetched from GET /equipment-requests/{id}/quote-document. Revoked on exit to avoid leaking the blob.

acceptAllowed.description: Whether the ENABLE_QUOTES global setting permits quote ACCEPTANCE for THIS REQUEST. Resolved in ProjectQuoteInitChain against the request's own origin (isExternalSource(requestType) -> 'CUSTOMER' | 'PROJECT'), NOT hardcoded to 'PROJECT' as it once was — this page is reached from the manager's Equipment Requests list, which serves both origins since filter=ALL, so an external request opened here was being judged by the project rule and had Accept greyed out under ENABLE_QUOTES=CUSTOMER. Gates the Accept button ONLY: viewing/downloading an existing quote stays open regardless (the setting gates creation and acceptance, not reads). Starts false and is only raised after the header fetch succeeds, so a failed or slow load never shows an Accept that would 403.
